candidate_practices.name: State the structural change enabling the result
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify transformations, reformulations, or architectural conditions underlying their claims.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes novelty assessable as a changed mathematical formulation rather than a priority assertion.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'a novel framework' with the permitted transformations or parameter relationships, followed by the result they enable.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not claim equivalence when the reformulation is heuristic.

support.specific_example: Expert and gate permutations precede MoE matching.
Single-layer linear-attention learning is recast as RKHS prediction.
Four transformation classes accompany multi-model and heterogeneous-width alignment.
Width-degree relationships delimit identifiability; tensor uniqueness supplies the proof strategy.

contrasts.contrast: The central change concerns spectral error and conditional bounds, rather than model reparameterization.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact equivalences, symmetry scope, theorem assumptions, and transformation-specific results.

candidate_practices.name: Attach components to the diagnosed obstacle
candidate_practices.source_observation: Method abstracts pair named operations with particular capability deficits or system requirements.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can assess design relevance without treating intended roles as established causal effects.
candidate_practices.application: For each essential component, write 'operation X targets requirement Y'; label causal diagnoses as proposed where appropriate.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not assign independent roles when the contribution depends on inseparable interactions.

support.specific_example: Boosting targets classification-ability disproportion rather than learning balance alone.
Dynamic hyperbolic radius adjustment targets visual-textual granularity mismatch.
Motion injection targets part control; joint reconstruction targets scene consistency.
Multimodal fusion supplies feedback, foresight initializes trajectories, and an auxiliary loss targets credit assignment.

contrasts.contrast: Spectral mapping, spatial detail, and aggregation are functional roles without requiring separate failure diagnoses.
Novel objects, multistage tasks, and complex instructions organize capability scope as well as component rationale.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether diagnoses are demonstrated and components actually deliver their assigned effects.

candidate_practices.name: Separate measurements that could reverse the headline
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish failure-specific measurements, capability dimensions, or evaluation regimes.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the distinction can prevent one favorable score from standing in for a broader capability.
candidate_practices.application: Identify two meanings of the claimed improvement and report their separate outcomes, including parity or reversals.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Avoid arbitrary subdivisions when the target has one meaningful outcome.

support.specific_example: Absorption receives a detection metric; size and sparsity changes reportedly do not resolve it.
Small-k RLVR gains coexist with large-k reversals and reasoning-path distribution analyses.
Training-knowledge parity differs from new-task and in-context advantages.
Reasoning categories are distinguished from reasoning, consistency, and plausibility scoring dimensions.

contrasts.contrast: LLaDA combines benchmark comparisons, dialogue cases, and a narrow reversal task; these remain different evidence types.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Metric definitions, dimension dependence, sampling budgets, and comparison protocols.

candidate_practices.name: Make resource structure answer the research question
candidate_practices.source_observation: Resource abstracts connect annotations, pairing, or data variation to specific evaluation needs.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: a resource becomes a substantive contribution through what it makes measurable.
candidate_practices.application: Specify the missing observation, the field or pairing that supplies it, and the analysis it enables.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: For exploratory collections, do not retrofit unestablished task requirements.

support.specific_example: Camera-motion data address world-coordinate estimation; training comparisons use BEDLAM and BEDLAM2.0.
Coral-specific questions accompany ecological coverage and marine-biologist-assisted construction.
Paired geodata separate retrieval from matching and support domain-shift analysis.
Rare pathologies, acquisition variation, narratives, and boxes support an evaluation-only clinical stress test.

contrasts.contrast: Comparison infrastructure can instead consist of explicit tuning budgets and unified implementations.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Annotation validity, coverage, splits, access conditions, and whether training comparisons hold other factors fixed.

candidate_practices.name: Bind operational claims to workload and retained quality
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify configuration sensitivity or pair resource gains with task-quality claims.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this identifies what the reported number measures and what trade-off remains unresolved.
candidate_practices.application: Write workload, resource metric, comparison target, and quality outcome together; distinguish kernel latency from end-to-end cost.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent resource measurements for work that reports only parameter counts.

support.specific_example: Reported accuracy and response-length variation retains bfloat16, greedy decoding, model, and configuration context.
Cache reduction and FlashAttention latency accompany task retention and multi-query reuse.
Grafting reports FID against the original model and compute cost; PixArt speedup accompanies a GenEval decline.
Compression is paired with clean and adversarial accuracy, although compression units are unclear.

contrasts.contrast: VBench and 5-second 720p generation speed address separate outcomes; the extraction does not establish matched comparison settings.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Hardware, timing boundaries, overhead, matched quality, and units.

candidate_practices.name: Distinguish the observation from its explanation
candidate_practices.source_observation: Dynamics and diagnostic abstracts connect specific behavior patterns to proposed explanatory accounts.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: preserving this separation yields a reusable insight without overstating mechanism.
candidate_practices.application: State the measured or analyzed pattern first, then its interpretation and governing regime.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not introduce temporal phases or mechanistic explanations unsupported by the study.

support.specific_example: Separated timescales connect complexity growth with late feature unlearning in specified large-system regimes.
Generation and memorization onsets scale differently; infinite-time behavior requires a dataset-size condition.
Signed momentum falls short; equal momentum parameters retain performance and permit a statistical interpretation.
Post-SDPA gating benefits are accompanied by nonlinearity and sparsity explanations.

contrasts.contrast: ACE's progressive tightening is a designed training path, not a discovered separation of natural timescales.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Mechanism tests, onset definitions, derivations, and limits of generalization.

candidate_practices.name: Connect a position to actors and mechanisms
candidate_practices.source_observation: Position abstracts connect normative claims to technical pathways, institutional tools, or named collaborators.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes a recommendation discussable without presenting predicted benefits as measured effects.
candidate_practices.application: Separate the value judgment, supporting observation or analogy, proposed mechanism, and responsible actor.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: A conceptual argument need not invent an implementation plan.

support.specific_example: Privacy and utility concerns motivate collection redesign and legal-ethical collaboration.
The EU AI Act supplies concrete tools for an argument linking regulation and innovation.
Rapid personalization and engagement incentives motivate predicted harms and oversight, especially for minors.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Evidence behind analogies, causal claims, institutional effects, and proposal details.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Locate useful representations before proposing extraction.
unusual_but_useful.application: Name intermediate-layer utility and task-specific alignment separately.
Pair the universal lower bound with an existential matching class at each dimension.
unusual_but_useful.limit: This is not an upper bound for every class.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Make cross-stage observability the resource contribution.
unusual_but_useful.application: List training stages and released datasets alongside the model suite.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Release claims do not establish reproducibility.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate model homogeneity from preference calibration.
unusual_but_useful.application: Distinguish within-model repetition, cross-model similarity, and human preference variation.
Specify operations and expected outcomes before reporting accuracy.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Functional success does not establish aesthetic quality.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs an explicit literature gap and one algorithmic contribution.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Resources, scaling studies, and positions support other coherent structures.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Reported benefits prove the proposed mechanism or selection value.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Abstract claims establish neither causality nor conference selection causes.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: A strong benchmark claim establishes broad superiority.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Task scope, sampling regime, and comparison conditions can change the conclusion.

source_checks_needed.issue: Verify under 1 ms for 9K×9K and what timing includes.
Resolve whether 'over 94' means ratio, percentage, or omitted notation.
Clarify the subset receiving 25 annotations; do not apply that count to all 26K queries.
Operations and expected outcomes appear under S5/S6 in the narrative, but the lesson cites S4/S6.
Extraction says the method name is obscured; verify correspondence with HyperET.
Verify quantification of the prior upper bound; avoid implying universal O(√d).
Evaluation-only status does not prove training absence; percentage-gap denominators are unspecified.
A fully matched training comparison is inferred, not established by S8/S9.
Verify explicit support for foresight resolving early query ambiguity; buffer initialization is more directly supported.
